lessons.title: Negative-Override Precedence in AI Review Enrichment
lessons.problem: Keyword matching or unconstrained LLM tagging on phrases like 'BYOB' produces false-positive filter badges when a venue policy actually states 'no BYOB' or '$500 outside kitchen cleanup fee'.
lessons.solution: Always pair positive pattern extraction with explicit negative-override rules and attach verbatim evidence sentences (`verified_evidence`) to every listing badge.

lessons.title: Free-Lead-First Outreach Before Pitching $30/mo Featured Placements
lessons.problem: Local businesses ignore cold $30/mo directory pitches when a brand-new site is in the Months 1-3 SEO Valley of Despair with low organic traffic.
lessons.solution: Capture early buyer leads via free local group posts + a 'Get 3 Free Quotes' modal, forward 1-2 real leads for free, and only pitch the $30/mo Featured Partner upgrade after proving lead value.

lessons.title: Multi-Tier Web Fallback When Transcript Summary Sites Block Scraping
lessons.problem: Third-party YouTube transcript/summary websites frequently block direct HTTP fetches or paywall full transcripts.
lessons.solution: Combine targeted `google_search` snippets with creator newsletters/blogs and `gh` repository searches in Stage 1.2 (`RESEARCH_SYNTHESIS.md`) rather than relying on a single transcript endpoint.
